tools.name: search_courses
tools.description: Search Opendart Akademi software training courses (Java Spring Boot, .NET Core, Flutter, Android Kotlin, iOS Swift, React Native, Angular, Vue.js, DevOps, AI-assisted development, corporate training) and topic guides. Returns course title, short description (Turkish), page URL and English page URL.

tools.name: get_course_details
tools.description: Get the details of one Opendart course: official title, short description (topics, format, total hours as published on the course page), Turkish and English page URLs and related topic guides. Use after search_courses or when the user names a course. Does not include prices or dates; call get_course

tools.name: get_course_schedule
tools.description: Get the officially announced upcoming start dates of an Opendart course (live data from the site schedule): start date, weekly plan, session hours, total hours, group size and registration link. If no session is returned, say no date is announced yet and give the request form link; never guess a dat

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search Opendart's free technical articles and tutorials by keyword (Java, Spring Boot, .NET, Flutter, Android, iOS, React, Angular, Vue, DevOps, SQL, AI); returns up to 12 article titles and URLs.
